country.name: New Zealand
country.regulator: Sales promotions are allowed under the Gambling Act 2003; paid lotteries and raffles are regulated by the Department of Internal Affairs (DIA).
country.eligibility: Usually New Zealand residents aged 18+; check the terms.
tips: Check the promoter is named and the terms show the closing date and how winners are drawn.
You never pay a fee or give bank log-ins to claim a prize.
Paid lotteries and raffles should be run under DIA rules for authorised purposes.
country.paid_note: Paid lotteries in New Zealand are regulated by the DIA
